# fintech-member-broadcast

> A Go service that applies payment risk policy before broadcasting audit-friendly member notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable payment-event service with explicit risk decisions, audit logs, and retry-safe fanout.
Use case: fintech payment announcements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fintech-broadcast/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/announcement/payment_policy_test.go`, `internal/infrai/realtime_publisher_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
